features.forbidden: Target-period level, t-2 level, explicit lag-direction bit, record identifiers and future labels are excluded from fitter covariates
features.missing: Unknown, blank, nonfinite, negative, malformed or out-of-calendar values fail qualification; legitimate zero is preserved
features.period: Published MOH epi-week number (Sunday–Saturday), MAS month number, MSF annual period1; no ISO-week reinterpretation
features.previous_level: Fixed canonical Decimal magnitude bins: bin0 literal known zero; bin1 positive below1; bin2 [1,10), successive powers10, final bin14 exactly the bounded maximum1e12. Values above1e12, exponents or more than6fractional digits fail qualification.
features.series: Fixed exact full-published-source vocabulary; disease aliases remain separate series; no inferred clinical equivalence
features.year: Semantic calendar year integer, never an auxiliary-period lexical category or unknown zero

learning_plan.cohort_differences: Training and auxiliary sizes/periods differ: MOH8822vs1976;MAS156vs60;MSF4vs4. The public-only comparison includes these data-availability and temporal differences. Independent RR uses the exact same training cohort as continuation.
learning_plan.design: Intercept; calendar year centered at source first year and divided by10; fixed one-hot published period, fixed exact source series, fixed lag-level bins0..14
learning_plan.family: Affine ridge regression for binary probability forecasts; unpenalized intercept, slope penalty1, clip predictions to [0,1]
learning_plan.fit_rows: Certified continuation and independent RR use every registered training row. Public-only uses every separate registered clean auxiliary row. Test rows are used only for scoring.
learning_plan.public_only: Available public auxiliary-data comparator, not a matched-size mechanism-isolation contrast
learning_plan.public_only_fitter_inputs: Public encoded auxiliary covariates and exact clean auxiliary labels.
learning_plan.randomized_fitter_inputs: Public encoded covariates and fixed mechanism-marginal decoded randomized fresh bits only. No raw y,z,W,sourcekeys,sourceordinal or testtruth.
learning_plan.tuning: None; no outcome-based task, threshold, feature, cohort, seed, hyperparameter or margin changes

legacy_encoding_review.action: Detect and retain historical limitation; new public sources use semantic integer calendars and known-zero bins. Original matrices/evidence unchanged.
legacy_encoding_review.scope: Exact retained prepared-source lineage/vocabulary reconstruction, not full re-extraction of all US raw archives

mandatory_decision.decision_scope: Fixed finite held-out published frames conditional on one saved public retained-response vector
mandatory_decision.pass: All six strict research superiority comparisons pass

margin_justification.not_justified_by: Sample size, minimum detectable effect, MC width or a convenient arbitrary5percent/0.01 threshold
margin_justification.positive_operational_margin: Pending service-owner benefit, incremental cost/stakes and threshold-distribution evidence. Public research approval does not supply agency approval.

research.rationale: Strict risk reduction under a strictly proper probability score. With a declared uniform threshold reference, mean normalized decision cost equals Brier loss / 2; strict positive gain reduces that reference cost. This is a research benefit boundary, not an invented agency materiality threshold.

margin_justification.uniform_threshold_decision_loss_identity: Brier loss / 2 under normalized false-positive cost t and false-negative cost1-t, t uniform[0,1]

mechanism_plan.candidate: Optimal r=1 conditional fresh law, with exact certificate and retained/context bindings checked before any simulated conditional block
mechanism_plan.decoder: Mechanism-marginal binary decoder; fixed conditional-history decoder bias is retained rather than hidden
mechanism_plan.independent_comparator: Independent fresh RR ratio L/d=3; exact marginal accuracy3/4
mechanism_plan.public_only_comparator: Clean separate auxiliary labels; no randomized release
mechanism_plan.simulation_status: Future public-only simulation, not executed in Phase5; no protected disclosure or authoritative agency history accounting

purpose: Validate public semantic features and preregister three user-selected agency-domain historical forecast diagnostics. This registration does not evaluate fitted usefulness.

registration.kind: Local prospective plan registration, not independently administered preregistration
registration.ordering: Fixed plan/source/runtime identity reserved exclusively; preregistration flushed before artifacts; completion published last; no future outcome derivation, fitting or simulation before this registration
registration.phase5_action: Encoding/source validation and registration only; no binary outcomes, model fits, simulated retained history or fresh blocks generated
registration.request_overrides: Refused: fixed sources, tasks, margins, split, paths and seeds
registration.restart: Incomplete reserved registrations block across concurrent processes and restarts; completed records replay and redeliver exact artifacts
registration.source_values_inspected: Public CSV syntax, quantities and feature/calendar lineage are inspected for qualification before registration; source previews and known historical observations prevent untouched-holdout claims

representative_frame.dependence: Calendar cells and overlapping social-assistance schemes may be dependent; finite-frame scores do not require iid cells.
representative_frame.design: Complete finite-frame census, not a convenience subsample of those eligible held-out records
representative_frame.exclusions: Only fixed calendar/series lineage eligibility and predeclared temporal windows; preserve all missing-predecessor, early-period and renamed-series exclusions
representative_frame.inclusion_probability: 1/1 for every eligible held-out published observation
limitations: MOH reports notified historical disease-week cases, not individual patients or complete disease burden.
MAS series stops August 2015 and cannot support current monetary-policy or current financial-system usefulness.
MSF has only16eligible forecast cells,4train,4auxiliary and8test; precision and generalization are severely limited; scheme/overall cells are not unique mutually exclusive people.

These are historical downloaded publication vintages. Actual lagged values available at each forecast date, reporting delays and revisions have not been independently reconstructed; this plan is a retrospective fixed-vintage forecast diagnostic, not verified real-time forecasting.
representative_frame.sampling_uncertainty: None for a complete fixed finite frame. No iid, person-level, future-year or national-population confidence claim.
representative_frame.target: Every eligible published historical target observation in the declared held-out window, separately for each agency test bed
representative_frame.weights: Equal observation weights within each task; domains are separate mandatory decisions and not pooled by row count

scope.representation: Census of eligible published historical held-out observations only

target_recipe.eligibility: All three source observations must exist in consecutive publisher periods; no fill, interpolation, alias merge or cross-series linkage
target_recipe.exact_numeric_comparison: Integer counts or Decimal monetary values; no floating-rounding label rule
target_recipe.fresh_bit: y_t = 1 if exact published value at t is strictly greater than at t-1, else 0
target_recipe.retained_bit: z_t = 1 if exact published value at t-1 is strictly greater than at t-2, else 0
target_recipe.t: Target observation in the same exact published series

uncertainty_plan.batch_rule: Precompute the fixed ridge design factorization and process exactly256replicates per batch without changing ticket order, fitting rules, repetition count, plan or stopping based on outcomes. This is a future computation plan, not a tested Phase5 evaluator.
uncertainty_plan.covers: Conditional Monte Carlo integration on the fixed complete public test frames and saved retained history only
uncertainty_plan.descriptive_quantiles: Fresh-law loss quantiles and first reference model scores are descriptive, separate from simultaneous expected-gain intervals
uncertainty_plan.method: Simultaneous two-sided Hoeffding union bound over paired replicate gains in [-1,1], radius sqrt(2*ln(2*6/0.05)/16384)+1e-9 numerical guard
uncertainty_plan.metric: Mean held-out Brier loss over complete registered test frame
uncertainty_plan.paired_comparators: Common independent integer uniform tickets for each candidate/independent fresh bit; exact rational thresholds
uncertainty_plan.population_interval: Not applicable to fixed census; no future/population uncertainty evaluated
uncertainty_plan.random_generator: NumPy PCG64 with fixed public SHA256 domain-separated seeds; reproducible computational approximation to ideal independent tickets, not mathematical iid proof
uncertainty_plan.retained_history: One saved seeded public simulated retained RR vector per task; fresh-law integration conditions on this actual history
uncertainty_plan.stopping: Exactly16384replications; no optional stopping, favourable seeds or adaptive repetition increase
